'''Krin Koda''' was a legendary [[Scout/Legends|scout]] in the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At some point, he discovered [[Koda's World]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] which was eventually named after him, and saved the native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Tempestro]] from a ravaging disease. As a token of gratitude, they gave him the [[Eye of Koda]]. He thought that it was a map that led to a planet where ultimate power and wealth could be obtained. At one point, however, he disappeared.<ref name="TP" />
